(a) Does there exist a finitely generated simple group that is of exponential
growth but not of uniformly exponential growth?
   (b) Does there exist a finitely generated hereditarily just-infinite group that is of
exponential growth but not of uniformly exponential growth?                  E. Schesler
  ∗ Yes, Thompson’s group V provides an affirmative answer to both questions
(R. Sauer, E. Schesler, Preprint, 2026, https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30163).
